name: Mainline only
purpose: Keep both club lines clear and leave the full space behind them for your display.

name: Back-out siding
purpose: Park on 64 straight studs along the front. Reverse to return to the inner mainline.

name: Double crossover
purpose: Transfer between the two club lines within the mainline corridor.

name: Drive-through siding
purpose: Enter at one turnout and rejoin the inner mainline at the other.

name: Perpendicular freight spur
purpose: Follow the same right-side approach as the short spur, with 112 straight studs toward the rear.

name: Short perpendicular freight spur
purpose: Use 32 straight studs along the right side and keep the rear open.

name: Two-track arrival siding
purpose: Hold two trains along the right side on 80 and 64 studs of straight storage.

name: Rear parking siding
purpose: Turn back behind the display and park on 32 straight studs facing left.

name: Four-track right yard
purpose: Keep the inner mainline open. Three storage tracks end flush at the right edge.
